intro.text: Gigantic creatures of the Reshi Sea, hundreds of feet tall, whose legs reach the sea floor. Reshi islanders live on their backs and worship them as gods.

description.text: A Tai-na's legs are at least sixty feet long. Its eye is the size of a house and its huge mouth has massive mandibles; it enjoys fruit as a snack. Its skin is plated with carapace, and islanders carve stairs into the shell without harming it.
A whole ecosystem of grass, trees and shalebark lives on a Tai-na's back, and larkin, thought extinct since Aimia's scouring, lived on at least one.

The islanders believe the Tai-na favor boldness and read their movements as divine will. When two islands draw near, sometimes good things happen and sometimes they go to war: each island's king leads its soldiers in skirmishes with little bloodshed, won by the bolder side.

Islanders won't discuss a Tai-na's spren, which they call the island's soul, with outsiders, and keep even simple facts to themselves, so many educated foreigners have never heard of the Tai-na. They trade only with people they trust, and foreigners who settle there must give all they own to the king.
Tai-na can grow so large thanks to a bond with spren. Axies the Collector thinks their spren must be spectacular, and the Reshi refuse to let outsiders study them.

items.text: Rysn owed her life to Relu-na, which also, in some way, gave her a larkin.
The larkin, after nearly dying out, were taken in by Na-Alind, one family of Tai-na.
